## 📦 Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Nyx-Setup-x86_64.exe` (installer) or `Nyx-x86_64-windows.zip` (portable) |
| Linux, any distribution | `Nyx-x86_64-linux.tar.gz` |
| Debian, Ubuntu | `nyx-amd64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE | `nyx-x86_64.rpm` |
| Arch | `nyx-x86_64.pkg.tar.xz` |
| NixOS | `nix run github:BX-Team/Nyx/${TAG}` |
